question: Can the named registry rows name the weapon and attachment fields that are still only hashes (Field_440ed7fa, Field_b30a73ed, the ADS-time modifier receiver of L121), and do they change any earlier negative closure?

sourceFacts.method: Value matching across owners (owncmp.py): a hashed leaf is named by a registry row when it equals that row's default on at least 90 percent of the owners and the row has at least two distinct defaults. The named hashes were compared with FIELD_MAP.md, with the 15 hashes in OPEN_QUESTIONS.md, and with every Field_ hash in the title, summary, reopen condition and receipts of the 116 weapon, attachment and soldier leads closed as exhausted, rejected, parked, needs-capture, duplicate or superseded, or as findings worded as limits (list from the lead index).

control.description: The match names RateOfFire as Field_14c4a054 and InitialSpeed as Field_0bf4f62b, the names already recorded in FIELD_MAP.md (L1000).

inference: The earlier field naming from registry rows was complete for these three families: 101 of 102 value-matched names are already in FIELD_MAP.md.
Field_440ed7fa sits in the FireLogic block beside RateOfFire and the reload array, and no registry row carries its values. The registry cannot name it.
No hash cited by a negative closure gains a name by this method, so none of those closures is reopened by it.
unresolved: Field_440ed7fa, Field_b30a73ed and the ADS-time modifier receiver remain unnamed.
The one unlisted match, Field_0fb2d151 as AutoReplenishMagazine, rests on two distinct values and is a weak candidate only.
Attachment package fields were not screened: their registry rows under WeaponModifierDataAssets carry only a Priority value.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.
